# Checks

| check | runs on | description |
|---|---|---|
| `checkdoc` | main, business, test | checkdoc-current-buffer with autofix disabled. |
| `package-lint` | main, business | package-lint-current-buffer with the main file pinned. |
| `byte-compile` | main, business, test | Byte-compile each file; non-test files are loaded afterwards. |
| `blank-lines` | main, business, test, tooling | At most one consecutive blank line. |
| `heading-comment` | main, business, test, tooling | `;;;' headings (except autoload cookies) need surrounding blank lines. |
| `commentary-width` | main, business, test, tooling | Commentary lines must fit within the configured width. |
| `banned-construct` | main, business, test, tooling | Forbid configured constructs and suggest replacements. |
| `meta-info` | main, business, test, tooling | Header rules per class; per-class Commentary limits; known Keywords. |
| `module-name` | main, business, test | The file must provide its own filename base, as its last form. |
| `module-prefix` | main, business | Definitions must be namespaced; test and tooling modules are exempt. |
| `dependency-direction` | discovered .el files | Module requires must follow the configured layer rules. |
| `package-requires-emacs` | the main file | The declared emacs requirement must meet the configured minimum. |
| `emacs-version-minimum` | the running Emacs | The running Emacs must satisfy the configured minimum version. |
| `text-hygiene` | every tracked text file | Every tracked text file: no trailing whitespace, one final newline. |
| `policy` | the policy tables and the check registry | The policy tables and the check registry must agree. |
| `project-neutral` | ci/ and .github/ | The copyable directories: ci/ and .github/ never name the package. |

## Class profiles

| class | headers | may require | commentary lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| `main` | :require :package | business | 2-n |
| `business` | :require :submodule, :forbid :entry-only | business | 2-n |
| `test` | :forbid :package | main, business, test | 1-3 |
| `tooling` | :forbid :package | tooling | 1-n |
